verdict.rationale: Florida DOR's eServices handle taxpayer data, so a privacy question about whether that data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair one to ask. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The pack covers only reemployment tax filing, enrollment, login and E-Verify certification, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
